payload.title: File:Brasileodactylus araripensis (MCT.R.1473, CT mesh).jpg
payload.credit_html: "First evidence of a mandibular crest in Brasileodactylus Kellner, 1984 (Pterosauria, Pteranodontoidea, Anhangueridae), with comments on pterosaur headcrests"
payload.description_html: Three-dimensional mesh of MCT.R.1473 (Brasileodactylus araripensis). (a) Left lateral view, (b) right lateral view, (c) dorsal view, (d) ventral view, (e) anterior view, and (f) posterior view. al, alveolus; as, accessory sulci; dc, dentary crest; de, dentary; mg, mandibular groove; mr, mandibular ramus; nf, neurovascular foramen; odp, odontoid process; rt, replacement tooth; sy, symphysis; sye, symphyseal elevation; sys, symphyseal shelf; t, tooth. Scale bar equals 50 mm.
